tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rab tu gnas pa bum pa gnyis pa bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so//

"$ ༄༅// yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rjes smad du byung ba yi// rgyal dang bla ma rnams la gus btud nas// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i snying po 'di// 'thor ba bsdus te gzhan gyi don du bris// rab du gnas pa bum pa gnyis pa 'di la brten pa gsum ste/ gang gis byed pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ gang la rab du gnas par bya ba'i don/ ci ltar bya ba'i cho ga'i rim pa'o// dang po ni 'phags pa klu grub kyis mdzad pa'i rab du gnas pa'i gzhung las/ slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan// nus ldan mchog gis rim pa mkhas// zhes pas/ rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ tha ma yang bskyed rims la brtan pa thob pa gcig gis bya bar gsungs so// gnyis pa gang la bya ba'i rten ni/ ris su bris pa lugs su blugs pa dang*/ rdo shing 'jim pa la byas pa rnams te/ spyi sdom las// 'bum pa khang bu rgyal mtshan mchod rten brgya// rigs la sogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rten// bcu gnyis mdzad tshul mchog gi sprul pa dang*// glegs bam rdor dril la sogs pa'i// zhes so// de lta bu'i rten bzhengs par bya ba'i rim pa yang*/ lha khang dang rten mchod lta bu gsar du byed na sa'i cho ga dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa bya'o// thang ka la ras gzhi dang*/ rten gzhan gyi rgyu la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs pa grub na/ bzang ngo*// mdor na rten gyi bya ba thams cad grub nas nang rdzongs btub pa rnams dri bzang po'i lde gus byugs la gzungs dang ring bsrel la sogs pa'i rten rnams cho ga'i rim pa sngon du 'gro bas go rims ma log par bzhugs su gsol te zhabs bsdam mo// thang ka la sogs pa la ni gzungs rigs pa bris te/ de ltar na rten legs par grub nas/ gsum pa cho ga'i rim pa la gsum las/ dang po gnas ni mchod rten la sogs pa lha khang du bya ba'i gnas de nyid la/

gzhan dag la ni dben zhing bkra shis pa'i gnas gang yang rung bar bya'o// gnyis pa dus ni gza' dang rgyu skar dang tshes grangs bzang po'i tshe na bya'o// gsum pa bya ba'i rim pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos bzhi dang*/ rjes so// sngon 'gro la drug ste/ yo byad sta gon la gnas nas legs par bshams pa dang*/ bdag bskyed pa dang*/ bum pa bskyed pa dang*/ rten sta gon dang*/ ye shes pa spyan drangs shing snyan gsan dbab pa dang*/ rten dbab pa'o// dang po ni yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas nas bshams pa ni/ sngar sbyang ba ma byas pa'i sa yin na sa chog bya'o// de bas mdo lugs kyi bum gdan pad ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'am ma grub na nas kyi tshom bu bya'o/ dbus kyi lha la mchod pa'i don du gling bzhi ri rab bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad dang bcas pa bri/ rten dngos su bkrur rung ba yin na/ khrus stegs gru bzhi pa/ bkra shis kyi rtags brgyad dang ldan par rtsig pa'am bri'o// bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnyis gu gul gyis bdug cing sum bha nis bsangs la/ rdza yin na dkar zhal byug cig dar ma/ ras kyi mgul chings phal bum/ shugs pas kha brgyan la nang tshags gtsang mas bkang la/ sman la sogs pas 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga/ rin chen lnga la sogs pa'i bum rdzas blugs/ las bum du dri ma khrus kyi bsdud pa yin no// sder gtsang ma'i nang du 'bru bzang po blugs pa dang dri'i chu dang*/ khrus sder dang*/ bdag chal dang*/ na bza' la sogs pa rnams dang*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma ci 'byor pa bsams/ khyad par du chos skyong la gtor ma che ba gcig longs su bcas te/ rab gnas ma thon gyi bar du btang bzung ste/ der legs par bshams pa'o/ gnyis pa bskyed pa ni/ dpon slob thams cad kyi gso sbyongs blangs/ sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ bdag nyid yid dam gyi lha gang yin pa de'i bskyed rims bsdus pa gcig bsgoms la/

bzlas pa ci rigs pas bya'o// gsum pa bum pa bskyed pa ni/ bum pa la swa bha wa'i sngags kyis sbyangs nas ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa mi dmigs pa'i sa las/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhuṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du rin po che'i khri paṃ las pad ma a las zla ba'i steng du rten 'brel yongs su gyur pa las 'od 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po sku mdog gser gtso ma lta bu mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dpe byad brgyad bcu yis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar rten 'brel snying po 'od dang bcas pa bsgom zhing*/ de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs la bstim zhing mchod do// bzlas pa bya ba ni bum pa'i kha brgyan gseb du dung chos 'o mas bkang pa'i khar rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bzhag la bzung ste/ sngags kyi 'od zer bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs khar thim nas rten 'brel 'od dkar po bab pas gang bar bsam pa la/ rten 'brel brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs bzlas so// de nas spros pa la dga' na bcom ldan 'das 'od du zhu ba las rigs lnga bskyed la bzlas pa bya'o/ de nas las bum bsangs la/ rin po che'i bum pa'i nang du pad ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ las bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang sngon/ g.yas rdo rje dbyug pa g.yon sdig 'dzub can khro bo'i chas dang ldan pa gcig bskyed la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs te/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas/ oṃ a big+nan ta krid hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzla' bar bya'o/ yang rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ bzlas so/ spros pa la dga' na don yod grub pa dang gsum ka bskyed pa'i phyag len kyang yod do// me tog bsnyen pa ni 'bras bu rnams rten 'brel gyi yig 'bru'i rang bzhin du bsams la bzlas so// dri la oṃ a hūṃ bzlos// bzhi pa rten sta gon la yang bzhi las/

dang po la ni bgegs bsang sbyang ba la zhi bas sbyang ba ni/ ting lo dang bcas pa'i gtor ma gcig bgegs la bsngos la/ rten la lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba big+nan/ na maḥsarba ta tha ga te bh+yo/ bī na mu khe bh+ya/ sarba tad kham ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gh+ri h+ni i daṃ bha ling te swa hā/ zhes brjod la phyir btong*/ zhi drag gnyis kas sbyangs pa ni/ gu gul gyis bdug /ting lo dang chang bu sngar bzhin bsngos la sum bha nis bskrad pa'o// drag pos bskrad pa ni/ gu gul gyis bdug /khro bo'i sngags dang yungs dkar gyis brab cing*/ khro bo dang me ri dang mtshon chas/ rten la gal te bgegs zhugs pa yod na bskrad pa bya zhing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom mo/ gnyis pa sdig pa sbyang pa ni/ bdag gi mdun du til/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhaga~X la thams cad la bsgom du bcug ste/ snying khar kaṃ las sdig sgrib kyi ngo bo sdig pa'i gzugs su gyur pa/ lte ba nas hūm̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin du gyur pas sna sgo'i lam las ded nas til la thim par bsams te/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha kre lo kya bi dza yā/ kha kha kha hi kha hī/ sarba pa paṃ da hā na/ bha smi ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā/ zhes brjod cing mer bsregs chur dor ste phyi sgor dor ro// gsum pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni/ rten dngos su bkrur rung ba rnams dngos su bkru/ mi rung ba me long la gzugs brnyan 'char bar byas la bkru ba ni/ las bum blangs la/ khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi// byin brlabs ye shes chu yi ni// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus gsol bas/ dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /oṃ a mri te/ sarba ta tha ga ta/ ka ya bhi sho dha ni swa hā/ zhes bkru'o/ de nas dri ma khrus la sogs su yod na de dag gis bkru/ de med na yid kyis bkru zhing*// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin brlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub rtsol bar mdzod// na ma sarba ta tha ga ta ka ya wa ka tsit+ta bhi sho dha na hūṃ phaṭa swahā/

zhes bsdu'o// de bzhin du// 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong pa dri yis= khrus legs= na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta ma la sna na pū tsa me ga sa mud tra sma ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ/ 'di ni tshul khrims= khrims 'chal dri ma= tshul khrims dri yis= khrus legs= na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pha la sna na pū dza le ga sa mud tra s+pha ra ṇa sa la ye hūṃ/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin= khong khro'i dri ma= khrus legs= na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+ru hī sna= 'di ni/ brtson 'grus= le lo'i dri= brtson 'grus dri yis= khrus legs= na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta las sna na= 'di ni bsam gtan= rnam g.yeng dri ma= bsam gtan dri= khrus legs= na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta sha ta sna na= 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// shes rab dri yis legs bgos chu// khrus legs mdzad la khrus bgyi'o// na maḥsarba tha ga ta ma ni sna na pu dza me ga sa mu tra sma ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis khrus bya'o// de dag gi bar bar du dar ram ras dkar po dri ma ma gos pas sku phyi zhing ngag du/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyi'o// mi shes dri ma ma lus kun bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /ka ya bhi sho dha ni swa hā/ zhes brjod pas sku phyi'o// gzhan yang spros pa la dga' na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// zhes bya ba dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa gang shes kyi khrus gsol lo// bzhi pa/ rten bskyed pa ni/ rten rnams swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya ba'i steng du/ pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ lha ngo shes pa rnams de nyid kyi skur bskyed/

yang na mdo lugs las thams cad rten 'brel las bcom ldan 'das kyi skur bskyed la/ slar yang lha so so'i rnam par bsgyur kyang rung ngo*// zhes gsungs so// gzhan mchod rten dang lha khang la sku'i rigs kyi lha rnams bh+ruṃ las rnam snang po ti dang gsung gi rigs kyi lha rnams sa las 'od dpag med du bskyed/ rdo rje dang thugs kyi rigs kyi lha rnams hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa/ nor lha la sogs pa yon tan gyi rigs kyi lha rnams dziṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan/ ma mgon la sogs pa phrin las pa'i rigs kyi lha rnams khaṃ las/ don yod grub pa bskyed kyang rung ngo*// de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs so// rten sta gon no// lnga pa ye shes pa spyan drangs shing snyan gsan dbab pa la gsum la dang po spyan drangs pa ni/ rol mo bsgrag cing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ji ltar sangs rgyas rnams ni dga' ldan nas// sprul pa dam pa tog dkar lha yi bu// mi pham mgon la rgyal tshab dbang bskur bas// gzigs pa rnam bzhis 'dzam bu'i gling gzigs nas// glang chen thal dkar ltar gshegs lhums zhugs ltar// rdo rje rin chen pad ma'i rigs mchog dang*// las kyi rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// deng 'dir bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren na// rten mchog 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol// na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod la lag pa'i sor mo rnams bsnol zhing se gol brdab pa'o// de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan khyed ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// pad ma ka ma la ye stam/

zhes gdan 'bul la/ gnyis pa mchod bstod bya ba ni/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa me tog la sogs pa ji ltar shes pa rnams kyis gnas skabs dang sbyar la/ rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas mchod par bya'o// bstod pa ni/ rjes dran dang*/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can// phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral bde ba'i dgongs pa can// phan dgongs khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa'i sgrib kun nges par grol// 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon// khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab// thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can dag ni thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul// nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la// brtser bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'// thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni// mnyam par bzhag cing dri kun gyis// legs 'don khyod la= brten dang rten pa bshad bya dang*// gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la// blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' ba'i// legs ston khyod la= gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de// de dag skad cig sems can gyi// 'ongs dang 'gro nges 'byung gis// legs 'doms khyod la= sems can kun gyis khyod mthong nas// skyes bu dam pa legs par 'tshal// mthong ba tsam gyi rab dang pa'i// mdzad pa khyod la/ len dang gnas dang stong pa dang*// sprul dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang*// ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la// mnga' brnyes khyod la= thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba la// sems can rnams la rab slu ba'i// bdud 'joms khyod la/ rang gzhan don du ye shes dang*// spangs dang nges 'byung gegs byed pa// ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis/ mi rdzi khyod la= bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba// 'khor gyi nang na bag kyang bsrung*// kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pa// 'khor bsdud khyod= /kun mkhyen khyed la rgyu ba dang*// gnas pa kun la rtag par ni// kun mkhyen mi spyod mi mnga' des// yang dag don ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal/

sems can kun gyi bya ba la// khyed ni dus la mi 'da' bas /mdzad pa rtag du don mnga' bas// mi bsnyel khyod la// 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du// lan drug du ni so sor gzigs// thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i// phan bde dgongs khyod la= /spyod pa dang ni rtogs pa dang*// ye shes dang ni nges 'byung la// nyan thos sangs rgyas kun gyi// bla ma khyed la= /sku gsum dag ni byang chub che// rnam pa kun bsnyel thams cad du// 'gro ba kun gyi the tshom dag /gcod pa khyod la= /'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'// rnyog pa mi mnga' mi gnas pa// mi g.yo'i chos rnams thams cad la// spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo /dam pa'i don ni grub pa ste /sa kun la ni nges par 'byung*// sems can rnams kyi mchog tu gyur// sems can thams cad rnam grol mdzad// yon tan mi zad mnyam med ldan// 'jig rten dag dang dkyil 'khor na// snang ba lha dang mi rnams kyis// rnam kun mi mthong khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes bya ba la sogs pas bstod par bya'o// de nas snyan gsan bab pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yan dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyis khams na bzhugs pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang*/ bde ba'i don gyis phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la'ang mchod pa'i don du gnas par bgyid par 'tshal na 'dus pa thams cad byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ nang par rten 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ ces lan gsum bya'o// drug pa rten dag ba ni/ thog mar rten rnams kyi spyi bor 'khor lo'i lte ba la ā+oṃ/ mgrin pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba āḥ snying kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ bsams te/ dar ser po gdong g.yogs gsol te/ oṃ badz+ra wa ṣ+ṭha hūm̐ zhes so// de'i don ni rgyal bu rgyal sa ma bston pa dang yi ge mi gsal ma bcug gi bar mchod pa mi dbang ba yin no// zhes gsungs so// de ltar bstan pa rnams sngon 'gro'o// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/

cho ga'i sngon du bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi nyid dang*/ mnga' dbul ba'o// dang po cho ga rgyas par byed na/ phyi nang tho rangs kyi dus su/ yang sngar bstan pa bzhin/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ bdag skyed pa gsal gdab/ bum pa la sogs pa'i mdun skyed kyang gsal btab bo// mchod bkod yi ge mi gsal bya/ bum pa ma zlas kyang rung*/ spros pa la dga' na/ til sbyangs pa dang*/ bkru zhing phyi ba rnams kyang sta gon gyi skabs bzhin du bya'o// de nas sngar bsten bskyed pa rnams gsal gdab/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa dang bstod pa sta gon du bshad pa ltar ci rigs su bya'o// de nas me tog rnams la rten dhon ci rigs su byas bsdu'o// dngos gzhi nyid la drug las/ gsol ba gdabs pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug cing me tog dor ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ spyan dbye ba dang*/ brtan par bya ba'o/ dang po ni/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa rnams dang 'di rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byas bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa yon tan thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rdo rje'i rigs dang*/ rin chen rigs dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs dang*/ las gyi rigs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dbus med pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ rten 'di rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lan gsum pa la byon nas kyang bstan par bzhugs su gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ ye shes pa bzhugs cing me tog dor ba ni/

oṃ na mo bhū dha ya/ na mo dhar ma ya/ na mo sa gha ya/ oṃ ye dha ma he dun pra bha wa/ he dun te/ ṣan ta tha gha to/ h+ya ba dad te ṣan to yo ni ro dha/ e waṃ bha ni ma hā shā ma ṇa ye swā hā/ ces brjod nas/ me tog gi char dbab cing*/ rol mo dang bkra shis kyi sgra sgrags te/ ting nge 'dzin phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams nas 'bras bu dang tha dad med par byon nas/ rten so so la thim par bsam zhing*/ gnyis su med par bsam mo// de nas nang bskur ba ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das dang*/ bdag yid dam du skyed pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i par/ a bh+ru hī sna na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi brgyud bskul nas/ rin po che'i bum pa phyag na bsnams pa byin cing dbur bar bsams ste/ rol mo sgrag cing dbyangs dang bcas pas ngag du// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur ro// bzhi pa sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dri'i chus lha rnams kyi gnas gsum du reg nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin gyis brlab cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med par bya'o// reg du mi rung ba rnams la ni me long la gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la bya'o// lnga pa spyan dbye ba ni/ gser gyi thur mangs gis spyan la byug cing*// kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthas btugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bhi shudha ni swa hā/ zhes brjod pa dang spyan dbye'o// drug pa brtan par bya ba ni/

rdo rjes rten la reg cing ngag tu// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ma thob kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag du rten 'di la yang ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas zhig par ma gyur gyi bar du/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bzhugs su gsol lo// gsum pa mang du dbul ba la gnyis las/ dang po spyir 'bul ba la yang mchod bstod gnyis las/ mchod pa me tog la sogs phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs gang shes 'bul// bsdus pa byed na// 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta argaṃ pra ti dza ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du me tog ji snyed yod pa dang*/ bdug spos ci= snang gsal ci= dri mchog ci= zhal zas ci= sgra snyan ci snyed yod pa dang*// ces bcug la/ rjes su yang rim pa bzhin du/ sarba la sogs pa'i mthar/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ ghan+dhe nai wā+e te shap+ta hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod la/ bstod pa ni dkon mchog gsum gyi rjes dran dang*/ sngar brjod pas/ gzhan ci rigs pas bstod par bya'o// gnyis bye brag tu mang du dbul ba la gsum las/ dngos sku gzugs la 'bul ba la thun mong ba dang*/ snyan dang*/ shangs dang zhal dbye'i phyir/ sgra dri ro dang tshem shing 'bul ba/ khyad par mchog gi sprul pa las// chos gos lhung bzed brag spyad 'bul// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs la// dbu rgyan song mangs phreng rgyan dang*// mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'bul lo// gling bzhi rin chen sna bdun dang*// bkra shis rtags dang seng ge'i khri// thams cad kun la 'bul bar bya'o// nye ring mi mnga' kun tu gsal// thub pa sgra 'dzin rab dag kyang*// dag phyed bdag gis 'bul lags kyis// 'gro rnams rtag tu chos thob shog

/oṃ badz+ra karma sho dha ya a hūm̐// zag bcas phung po dri spangs kyang*// 'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir// mos pas 'dzin spyad 'di phul bas// 'gro rnams tshul khrims dri thob shog /oṃ badz+ra ra mu dha ra ṇa āḥhūm̐// ro mchog brgyad ldan zhal zas 'di// dad pas rgyal la 'bul ba yis// chos kyi ro ni dag pa yis// 'gro ba thams cad tshim gyur shog /oṃ dhi bya mu kha ye hūm̐// rin chen ra ka bi ra yis// tshems zhing dad pas 'bul ba yis// rgyal ba'i gsung gi don rtogs shing*// 'gro kun skad du chos thob shog /oṃ badz+ra dhan dho shodha ni aḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bul lo// de nas so sor 'bul ba ni/ rab tu byung pa'i cha lugs chos gos thogs// ji ltar sman pa'i rgyal po mtsho byed kyis// rgyal ba'i sku la nam bza' gsol ba ltar// de bzhin 'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir// thar pa'i rgyan mtshan ngur smrig gsol bar bgyi/ oṃ bhi bya bha'i pi pra ma na ye swa hā/ lhung bzed de thogs la/ ji ltar rgyal po chen po bzhi yis ni/ de bzhin gshegs la lhung bzed phul ba ltar// de bzhin 'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir// yon tan snod du gyur pa 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ pu ka sa pa ri ga ri ye swahā/ spu gri thogs la/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang*// gzhan don bsgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spangs phyir// dad pas gser gyi 'dreg spyad 'bul bar gyis// 'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ka tsa mu la a hūm̐ swā hā// yang 'breg spyad kyi thun mong du sen mo breg pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ zangs mdog yid 'ong lhar mdzad skyon bral yang*// bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs kyi ni// sen mo breg spyad phul bas 'gro kun gyi// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra na ma tshe da na hūṃ swa hā/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin na/

dbu rgyan thogs la// bde gshegs sku la mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// byang chub mchog gi brgyan kyis mdzes lags kyang*// rin chen dbu brgyan dar dpyangs la sogs pa// brgyan gyi khyad par dam pa dgod par 'bul// oṃ rad na a laṃ ka ra hūm̐/ de nas dung gi so mangs gis dbu skra bshad pa'i tshul byas la// dbu skra lcang lo mthon 'thing g.yas 'khyil ba// rin chen 'bar bas brgyan pa rab du mdzes// lha mi kun gyi blta bas mi ngoms te// bsam gtan thob phyir rgyal ba'i dbu skra bshad// oṃ dkar mi da ra li hūm̐/ de nas phreng rgyan la sogs pa thogs la// rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin mtshan ldan phyir/ rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*// rin chen brgyan mchog 'bul bas 'gro kun gyis/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a lang ka ra bhu sha ni a hūṃ swahā/ de nas sa phran brtsegs 'bul ba ni// 'gro ba sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ rigs pa'i gnas lnga dag la bslab bya ces/ ci ltar thugs dam rgya chen bzhengs pa yis// 'kho ba'i yo byad rnams ni 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra a ba yu ga sa ba ra ka ye swahā/ yang de dag la thun mong du 'bul ba bzhi las/ dang po gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ri mo 'bul bar bya'o// sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog tor// ri rab gling bzhi legs par brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro rnams rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra re ke a hūṃ swa hā/ de nas rin chen sna bdun 'bul ba ni/ rgyas par gzhan nas bshad pa ltar bya ba'am/ bsdus par byed na// mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag gis// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sa ta ma hā ra na pu dza me ga aḥhūṃ swahā/

de nas bkra shis kyi rtags la sogs 'bul ba ni// theg mchog bla res gdugs dang ba dan dang*/ bdud bcom rgyan mtshan lhab lhub lda ldi 'phan// gar dang rol mo mchod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par brgyan par bgyi// ji ltar mi dbang 'khor lo bsgyur ba yis// rin chen sna bdun tshogs dang ldan pa ltar/ rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la// rin chen sna bdun tshogs rnams 'bul bar bgyi// lha yi rgyal po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi// 'jig rten khyim bdag rnams ni dpa' brten nas// bil ba ltar dkar bum pa bzangs dang bcas// bdun du brdar nas bkra shis byed pa ltar// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi// de nas 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni// gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i// mchog du gyur pa'i longs spyod rnams// bdag gi dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ dhaṃ bya a na ye sa ma ta dhi ni pad na hūṃ phaṭa swahā/ zhes bya ba'i pu tsa lnga yang bya'o// de nas seng ge'i khri 'bul ba ni/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri// yid 'phrogs sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di// spros bral rgyal ba mchog la phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par shog /oṃ badz+ra a bha na ye hūṃ swa hā/ de dag gis sku gzugs la mnga' dbul ba'o// gnyis pa mchod rten la mnga' dbul ba ni/ rdo rjes srog shing dang rgyan gyis ming ci 'bul ba la reg cing*// byang chub shing mchog chos 'khor gdugs kyis brgyan// cod pan chu srin rgyan mtshan phreng pa dang*// rin chen brgyan mchog yid 'ong mdzes pa 'di// bsod nams phun sum tshogs phyir 'bul ba yis// 'gro rnams bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shog

/oṃ badz+ra pu tsa na āḥhūm̐/ gsum pa glegs bam la 'bul ba la gsum la/ dang po la nam bza' 'bul ba ni// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra bas// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir dbul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra watra āḥhūṃ swa hā/ gnyis pa glegs shing 'bul ba ni// zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral yang*// thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i// nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel dgag bya ba// phul bas skye bos zung 'jug rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+rā prañdza u pa sa ma ya la dha ya aḥhūṃ swa hā/ gsum pa glegs thag 'bul ba ni// spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur cig /ye shes chen po ro cig gyur pa ltar// glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad mchog phul bas// 'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra puk+ṣa ka bhan dha ya āḥhūm̐ swa hā/ de dag ni glegs bam la mnga' 'bul ba'o/ de nas brtsa ru'i bza' bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mnyes par bya ba ni/ snod bzang po'i nang du lha bshos chen po brgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan la bzhag /de'i tha ma na bza' ba dang/ btung pa sna tshogs bshams la/ na maḥsarba ta tha ga te bh+yoḥ bhi sha mu khe bh+ya/ sarba tad kham ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swahā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la// zhal zas ro brgya ldan pas yid 'phrogs pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin chos la spyod par shog /oṃ dhi bh+ya a ka ni/ sa ma dhi bya na sra ba ne swahā/ zhes pas 'bul bar bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga lnga las/ chos skyong bgo ba dang*/ mchod cing bzod par gsol ba dang*/ yon bdag bsgo ba dang*/ shis pa brjod pa dang*/ dga' ston bya zhing bsod nams bsngo'o/ dang po ni chos skyong bsrungs ma spyi la gtor ma btang*/

khyad par du nag po chen po dang rnam thos kyi bu la sogs pa la gtor ma btang ste/ chos skyong ba'i bsrung pa ma khyed rnams kyis rten 'di rnams yon bdag bgyis las/ phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du srungs shig /zhes brjod la/ gnyis pa ni yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// tshangs spyod lha yi tshogs rnams kyis// gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la// 'gal zhing 'khrul pa mchis pa dang*// ma tshang ba dang lhag pa dang*/ nongs par gyur pa gang lags te/ de kun bzod pa mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// gsum pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ sbyin bdag la/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i// sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du// ji ltar bsrungs pa de bzhin du// de dag don ni nges byas te// de dag don ni grub zin gyis// ci med bar ni mchod par gyis// zhes brjod la/ khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa yi/ rab tu gnas pa legs par tshar bar byas kyis/ khyod kyis rten 'di la zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig /de nas kyang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par gyis shig /ces bsgo'o// bzhi pa bkra shis bya ba ni// me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi// ye shes rgya mtsho mchog du dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /gh+ri haṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas// nyon mongs zug ngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi bar shog /dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar phyed pas ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshe ni 'phel bar shog

/bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang don ni grub gyur cig /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i don// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// chos rnams ma lus yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshig dbang thob par shog /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma lus dbang du 'dus nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab du brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang chos nyid brtan gyur cig /yungs dkar rdo rje'i rigs de thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus rab du 'joms byed cing*/ mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi// bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi bar shog /lnga pa dga' ston bya zhing bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ dga' ston gyi mchod pa dang*/ dge 'dun la dga' ston dang*/ rab tu gnas pa'i slob dpon la ci 'byor pa'i 'bul ba byas la/ slar yang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod la/ de'i 'og du/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bsngo ba gang rung ba bya'o// de dag ni rab tu gnas pa bum pa gnyis pa mdo dang stun pa'i cho ga'o// de la bsdus par byed par 'dod na/ sngon 'gro snyan gsan dbab pa yan chad byas la/ rten dgab pa dang*/ cho ga'i bya ba rnams bzhag la/ dang po dang drug po bya zhing mchod skyong kyi mnga' dbul ba tsam byas la/ gtor ma btang la chos skyong bsgo zhing bkra shis brjod par bya'o// gzhan rnams ni mi dgos so// bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyis shin tu bsdus par byed na// sems skyed la bdag nyid yi dam du bsgom/ swa bha wa'i sngags kyis rten sbyangs la/ rten rnams thub pa'i dbang por bskyed// sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ rten 'di rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab la/ ye dharma brjod cing me tog gtor la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs sam/ slar yang rten so so'i rnam par bsgyur la/ mchod bstod kyi mnga' dbul ba tsam brjod la bkra shis bya'o// shin du bsdus pa'o// da ni sngags lugs kyi rab du gnas pa brjod par bya ste/ sta gon gyi skabs su bca' gzhi snga ma dang mtshungs pa las/ lha gang la byed pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa ni khyad par ro/ gal he dbang bskur byed na dbang gi sta gon rnams 'tshogs par bya'o/ 'di la dri ma khrus kyi bum pa dang gsum dgos so// dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang bum pa sta gon du gnas pa thon nas sbyin sreg kyang bya'o// de nas dbang bskur ba yin na slob ma sta gon du gnas par bya'o// de'i 'og du rten sta gon bya ste/ gzhan snga ma dang mtshungs pa las/ rten bskyed pa'i skabs su yi dam gang byed pa der bskyed do// ye shes pa dgug cing mchod stod la sogs pa byas la/ sngon du lha la dbang bskur te/ de'i 'og du mi la dbang par bya'o// dngos bzhi drug po bzhin mdo lugs dang mthun pa las/ dbang bskur ba ni so so'i cho ga dang mthun par bya'o// rjes kyi cho ga ni mthun no// sta gon thon pa dang*/ rjes chog kyi cho ga'o// 'di ni sngags kyi lugs ste/ lha khang la sbyar yang nyan no// de nyid don dam du lha dang rab du gnas pa med/ kun rdzob tsam du de'i rnam par rab du bstan/ bya spyod rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams su/ bya ba'i rim pa rgya chen dpag med nas gsungs so// mdo'i lugs zhes gangs can rgyud du grags pa 'di// phal gyis shes min pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung grags pa// ti pam ka ra'i zhal nas gdam ngag ji bzhin du// skyon rnams spangs te 'jug pa shin du bde ba ru// gzhan la phan 'dod lhag pa'i bsam pas sbyar ba yin// rab du gnas pa'i rgyud slob dpon rin chen bzang po'i bsdus don dang*/

shākya shri bha tra'i rab du gnas pa'i cho ga rnams dang mi 'gal bar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen kra ra ba/ bya yul ba/ zhang sha ra la sogs pa'i man ngag 'thor bu ba rnams bsdus te/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa bzhin du/ rang byung rdo rjes sbrul lo la sbyar ba'o// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po byams pas/ slob dpon thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ rnam grol sde/ btsun pa rnam grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ bai ro tsa na/ seng ge bzang po/ rad na bha tra/ gu na mi tra/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ lo ts+tsha ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kra ra ba/ dpal dus sum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras pa/ spom brag pa/ bla ma karma wa/ bla ma gnyan ras pa/ rin po che rang byung rdo rje'o// bkra shis par gyur gcig/ dge'o// dge'o/ bkra shis/// /
